contractGoal: Record production deployment window ownership, rollback approver, migration direction, and secret source confirmation without executing deployment or rollback actions.

requiredConfirmationFields.name: deployment-window-owner
requiredConfirmationFields.description: Operator confirms who owns the production deployment window.

requiredConfirmationFields.name: rollback-approver
requiredConfirmationFields.description: Operator confirms who can approve rollback during the deployment window.

requiredConfirmationFields.name: database-migration-direction
requiredConfirmationFields.description: Operator confirms whether the deployment has forward-only migration, reviewed rollback SQL, or no database change.

requiredConfirmationFields.name: secret-source-confirmation
requiredConfirmationFields.description: Operator confirms the production secret source contract without reading secret values.

requiredConfirmationFields.name: rollback-sql-review-gate
requiredConfirmationFields.description: Operator confirms the SQL review gate before any rollback SQL can be considered outside this sample.

requiredConfirmationFields.name: operator-approval-placeholder
requiredConfirmationFields.description: Operator approval remains a manual placeholder and is not automated by Node.

forbiddenOperations: Executing Java deployment from this runbook contract
Executing rollback SQL from this runbook contract
Reading production secret values from this runbook contract
Modifying Java runtime configuration from Node
